opening.argument: The title presents Binance arbitrage as a beginner guide capable of making 100,000 per month, while the demonstration places participation inside Binance P2P trading. The speaker describes buying from and selling to other users, requires at least 100 USDT before selling, and illustrates a proposed BTC-for-fiat transfer. The displayed NGN buy and sell views, together with the NGN deposit form showing 9,000 NGN, connect the opportunity to both crypto and fiat funding. The presentation also directs viewers to register and verify through a link. These facts establish a promoted trading-return opportunity with high earnings language and funding requirements, while the available evidence does not establish completed losses, guaranteed outcomes, or the trustworthiness of any specific counterparty.
